content.body:
The Bf 109F series was an improved model over the earlier 109E series. It boasted a higher climb rate and top speed. It lost the the 20 mm cannons from the wings (improving its roll rate) and carried a single high velocity 15 mm cannon mounted in the "V" of the engine cylinders, firing through the propellor hub. Extra wingspan improved its sustained turn rate but being a little heavier it couldn't pull as tightly into the instantaneous part of the turn compared to the lighter E model.
This aircraft is sometimes referred to as the "Franz" for the "F" model designation.
content.brief: TYPE: Fighter Interceptor MAX. SPEED: 601 km/h WEIGHT: 2,750 kg CREW: 1 ARMAMENT: 15 mm MG151 Cannon (1) 7.92 mm MG17 LMGs (2)
